environment.description: Container running on ECS Fargate with default task role. Container runs as root with default Linux capabilities. Network mode is 'awsvpc' with full VPC access. IMDSv1 enabled on the host. No network policies restricting egress from the container. The container can reach the metadata service at 169.254.169.254 via DNS rebinding (bypassing the code's IP check through TOCTOU).
